title: finding(plugin-gantt,core): plugin-gantt reads a date-only task end as that day's START, so its own catalog plans draw one day short with a one-day gap, while the timeline gantt now reads it inclusively
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites, class (a). `reach:` named producers.
- **Producers.** `plugin-gantt`'s own catalog examples author inclusive date-only ends with next-day successors, for example:
  - `examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas/plugin-gantt/project-timeline-with-dependencies.json`: `2024-01-01..2024-01-15`, successor starting `2024-01-16`;
  - `sprint-development-timeline.json`: `01-01..01-03`, then `01-04`;
  - `construction-project-phases.json`: `02-01..02-14`, then `02-15`.
- **How they draw.** `plugin-gantt` draws each of these bars one day short, with a one-day gap before its successor. This was read at source and verified at base `9fd6c2c6f` by PR objectui#11138's contract review.

Reader: triage first (grade and route), then the seat that dispatches it. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`) at the ACCEPT of PR objectui#11138 (objectui#11112). objectui#11112's triage (`5893731138`) ordered: "Before changing, read `plugin-gantt`'s own date-only end convention. If it differs, report it on this card, so the two gantt surfaces are made to agree in one place". This card is that report's carrier. The source is the dev report's `open_questions[0]` (option A), escalated by the review (`5897894520`, ③). ⛔ Not graded here.

## The divergence

- **`plugin-timeline`** (PR objectui#11138): a date-only `endDate` is **inclusive**. It is drawn through the end of the named day, i.e. the next local midnight, per objectui#11112's triage ruling. Date-only is decided by the shared `isRealCalendarDate`, and the rule is declared on `TimelineGanttItemBar.endDate`.
- **`plugin-gantt`** reads an end exactly like a start, which makes it effectively **exclusive**:
  - `ObjectGantt` `readTaskDate` puts a date-only end at the named day's local midnight (pinned by `ObjectGantt.noSchemaZone-10866`: "a stored 2026-10-05 to 2026-10-09 reads as those days at local midnight");
  - `GanttView.styleFor` draws to `dateToX(end)`;
  - `scheduling.ts` names "the (exclusive) end instant";
  - `toStoredDateValue` writes the day at the bar's right edge.
- Before PR objectui#11138 the two surfaces agreed only by omission. Now one authored date-only end draws one day apart in the two views, and no parse can see the difference, because the value is legal in both.

## Direction (for triage: inherit objectui#11112's inclusive ruling, the dev's option A)

- One end rule, hoisted into `@object-ui/core` as one exported helper: a date-only end steps to the next local midnight. `plugin-timeline`'s `readGanttBarEnd` and `ObjectGantt`'s `readTaskDate` read it for `end` and `baselineEnd`.
- The inverse for writes: `toStoredDateValue` maps an exclusive right edge back to the previous day for a date-only END field, so a drag writes the day the author means.
- `GanttView` and `scheduling` stay half-open instants, which they already are.
- `plugin-gantt`'s end pins are re-derived. The tooltip duration and a dragged end's write-back change by one day, so the three catalog plans then draw their authored ends.
- The alternatives the dev weighed:
  - (B) keep the two readings and document each, which is a permanent two-dialect state;
  - (C) revert the timeline to exclusive, which works against every measured producer.

## Dedupe

The 1162 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed (down to #2231), were grepped:
- `inclusive end` (3 hits) and `exclusive end` (2 hits): objectui#11112 itself, a calendar DST PR and the seat post.
- `readTaskDate` (2), `toStoredDateValue` (3) and `one day short` (2): closed DST and zone PRs (objectui#10886, #11055, #11036), plus objectui#11112 / PR objectui#11109.

None carries `plugin-gantt`'s end convention.
